currentR02.method: For each scanDate, mean(SELECTED returns) - mean(comparator returns), then aggregate date deltas.

structuralReason.formalArchitecture: GENERAL and THOUSAND are independent 3-slot pools with no cross-fill.
structuralReason.implication: Price-pool membership is an explicit selection-stratum and execution/liquidity regime; same-date matching alone does not equalize pool composition.

fixedSyntheticWitness.conclusion: Pooled same-date R02 can attribute price-pool composition differences to Selection Alpha.

preferredPromotionGradeEstimand.name: R02_POOL_MATCHED_V1_1
algorithm: For each scanDate and pool separately, compute comparator mean only if both SELECTED and comparator rows are available and quality-clean.
For each selected row, compare its return with the same-date same-pool comparator mean; equivalently weight each pool delta by selected count in that pool.
Aggregate first within date using actual selected-count weights, then aggregate across independent dates with equal-date primary weighting.
Report GENERAL and THOUSAND strata separately in addition to consolidated pool-matched result.
Do not substitute a comparator from the other pool when same-pool support is absent; mark that date/pool comparison unavailable.
preferredPromotionGradeEstimand.whySelectedCountWeight: Preserves the actual Formal selected pool composition while removing comparator pool-composition confounding.
secondarySensitivity: equal-pool weighting on dates where both pools are represented

guardrails: R02 v1.0 pooled result remains historical/descriptive and is not deleted.
R02_POOL_MATCHED_V1_1 is frozen before mature prospective outcomes are inspected.
Cohort-quality guards still apply; pool matching does not repair BROAD_CONTROL/NEAR_MISS/rejection semantics.
Same-pool support is mandatory; missing comparator support is UNKNOWN, not cross-filled.
Do not add industry/channel matching until separately preregistered; avoid endless matching degrees of freedom.
scanDate remains the primary independent inference unit.
